name: Hermes agent (hermes acp)
role: opt-in executor. Not selected unless --backend hermes is passed, or "hermes" is listed in routing.default_order
invoke: hermes acp (long-lived ACP session over stdio; initialize, then session/prompt turns)
stdin: stdio pipe carrying ACP JSON-RPC (Content-Length framed)
binary_resolution: policy hermes.binary, else ~/.local/hermes/bin/hermes; the file must exist and be executable, else the planner reports "no working hermes binary"
model: --model / lane model, else policy hermes.model (null = hermes' own default); exported to the child as HERMES_MODEL
provider: policy hermes.provider, default minimax-cn; exported to the child as HERMES_INFERENCE_PROVIDER
quota_source: none (unknown). The planner gates only on a working binary; usage an ACP turn result reports is recorded on the run, not used for routing
steerSupport: resident ACP: session/cancel ends the turn (stopReason cancelled) and the same session can be continued with a new prompt; one-shot runs have no live steer
streaming_events: ACP session/update notifications (agent_message_chunk text, tool_call and tool_call_update)
dataBoundary: worktree + the configured inference provider (default MiniMax via minimax-cn); hermes state stays local under HERMES_HOME (policy hermes.home, else ~/.local/hermes-home)
never: logging or persisting the provider API key: it is read from Pi's auth store (~/.pi/agent/auth.json, minimax-cn entry) and injected into the child environment only, under policy hermes.key_env (default MINIMAX_CN_API_KEY)
